Class NetworkService

java.lang.Object
service.NetworkService
public class NetworkService extends Object
Entry point of the service layer, used by the UI. It manages users and friendships and delegates the community queries to CommunityService.

Every successful change is also applied to the Connectivity, so the community queries are always up to date. The repository is changed first: if it fails, the connectivity is left untouched.
